title: Greedy argmax tie rule is split: sampling::argmax keeps the LAST maximum, fused LM-head loops and gguf/ops.rs keep the FIRST
evidence: crates/aprender-serve/src/sampling.rs:36 (max_by = last max; NaN passes the lead to the next element) vs gguf/ops.rs:329 and infer/gguf_gpu_generate.rs:341/843 (strict >, first max, NaN never wins); generate/mod.rs:278 sample_greedy is first-max but a NaN at index 0 wins. The same logits can give a different greedy token depending on the engine.
repro: argmax(&[2.0,1.0,2.0]) returns 2 through crate::sampling::argmax and 0 through crate::gguf::ops::argmax; argmax(&[1.0,f32::NAN,0.5]) returns 2 vs 0.

title: apr-cli keeps private argmax/sampler copies that cannot reach realizar::sampling without the inference feature
evidence: crates/apr-cli/src/commands/eval/inference.rs:196 sample_token (own xorshift RNG, greedy max_by) and commands/spc_color.rs:365 argmax are compiled without feature inference, where realizar is an optional dependency; serve/handlers.rs:120 wgpu_is_stop_token hardcodes 151645|0 instead of the model's stop list.

title: apr-cli feature `wgpu` does not build alone: it omits entrenar/gpu that commands/finetune.rs needs
evidence: cargo check -p apr-cli --lib --features wgpu fails with E0432/E0433 at crates/apr-cli/src/commands/finetune.rs:623,671,865,905,947; WgpuInstructPipeline is #[cfg(feature = "gpu")] in crates/aprender-train/src/finetune/wgpu_pipeline.rs:50 and Cargo.toml:109 is wgpu = ["inference"] only.
